​
I visited Holly Road Medical Centre due to a skin concern, with my anxiety heightened by a recent BCC scare and my documented social anxiety disorder and documented autism. Unfortunately, the appointment felt rushed and entirely dismissive.
​
The GP quickly summarized my concern using complex medical jargon and failed to acknowledge my emotional state. The lack of empathy meant the note created in the medical record failed to reflect my genuine level of worry.
​
This experience has a lasting negative impact.
